Very delicious food at average prices
Apr 2026 • Couples
Alpaca Homestyle Cafe offers European cuisine in the centre of Nha Trang. It is a two-storey building with a large hall on the second floor, comfortable chairs with soft cushions and a small balcony. Light interior, nothing too much. Of interest is the elevator for eating in the hall.
I ordered a bacon chicken breast with baby potatoes, and my husband ordered mushroom soup and burritos. The breast was juicy, tender, wrapped in juicy crispy bacon – just a treat. And again, no extra sauces and condiments. Unfortunately, I didn't take any photos because I was very hungry.
